unavailable: 请求未完成。请重新连接以读取持久状态。
unconfirmed: 取消尚未确认。任务可能仍在运行；重试前请重新连接。
name: 名称
label: 角色
autonomy: 无法统计成功的审批，因此自主权限提升不可用。仍需征得同意。
cloudUnavailable: 云电脑不可用。不会改在本机执行。
uncertain: 可能已产生外部影响。不能保证回滚，也不会重放操作。
parentMessage: 向原始 Bot 发送消息
copy.independent: Each accepted invitation creates an independent copy. Conversations, memory, secrets, connections, channels and the owner’s computer are not included.
copy.unavailable: This invitation or share could not be read or changed. Reconnect to check its current state.
copy.revokeNote: Revocation prevents future copies. Existing copies remain independent.
copy.credentials: Reconnect apps with your own credentials. Only plugin names are copied.
copy.declineNote: Declining closes this invitation. No copy is created. The sender can see your decision.
apps.title: Connected apps
apps.boundary: Account access is the ceiling. Each Bot also needs its own enable. Credentials and authorization links stay outside this screen.
apps.error: App or rule changes were not confirmed. Refresh to read the current state.
apps.consentNote: Choose where this app is available and when its tools ask. Authorization opens only after your explicit action.
rules.title: Tool permissions
rules.boundary: Per-Bot rules: Allow, Ask, Block. Organization rules and the account approval matrix can tighten access. Connection approval modes are separate.
hierarchyNote: 仅显示已保存的关系。不自动分配任务，也不继承权限。
leadUnconfirmed: 更改尚未确认。重新连接以读取已保存的关系，然后重新选择并保存。不会自动重试。
pending.boundary: Allow once or deny the linked request. Arguments and secrets are not shown. Deny skips the parked tool but may resume model inference.
pending.error: The request was not confirmed. Refresh to read actual pending requests; no decision is automatically retried.
pending.allowed: Allowed; no longer pending. This does not confirm tool execution success.
pending.denied: Denied; no longer pending. The parked tool is skipped; model inference may still resume.
pending.acknowledged: Widget acknowledged; no longer pending. No tool execution outcome is available.
pending.unconfirmed: Decision unconfirmed. Refresh pending requests before any new explicit decision.
pending.empty: No pending tool approvals in this list
pending.unlinked: No linked decision widget. Refresh to check again.
pending.auditBoundary: Policy audit only; run, deny and pause are not tool execution outcomes.
